path.description: Navigation path, the same as the string form

clearHistory.description: true replaces the history instead of pushing, so Back no longer returns to the page being left. Web replaces the current history entry. Mobile resets the app history: true makes the target the only screen; a path keeps that page under the target, so Back lands on it (web treats a path like true).

target.description: Browser target for externalLink, such as _blank. Defaults to _self.

delay.description: Milliseconds to wait after opening externalLink before the next action runs

navigate.description: Navigation path, or an object with path and clearHistory (replace the history instead of pushing) or externalLink
